status: authoring recommendations; no runtime shader change

units.normalStrength: relative starting multiplier; tune per asset

families.label: 木漆
families.brush: 横向搭接板顺纹擦色，补漆块方向不变

families.label: 裸木
families.brush: 宽大木纹与端面，潮湿区降低粗糙度

families.label: 灰泥
families.brush: 大色面、墙角薄擦色，少量裂纹

families.label: 石材
families.brush: 沿岩层分块，避免密集噪声

families.label: 织物
families.brush: 褶面与缝边清楚，织纹近景可见

families.label: 金属
families.brush: 宽阔断续反射，漆/锈/裸露分区

families.label: 玻璃
families.brush: 少量大块反射；磨砂版本粗糙度0.55–0.75

families.label: 水
families.brush: 横向宽色带、低频法线；泡沫粗糙度0.9

rules: Do not paint sun shadows or colored directional highlights into basecolor.
Named palette tokens are sRGB references, not measured reflectance.
Opaque overview glazing may use the current simplified reflection; do not enable transparency globally.
